publication issues.summary: Partial, unapproved. The original converter report records 246 unresolved render cells including 25 wire flags. Team7 reports native review of the flags, prefix rows and junction neighborhoods, but source SELECT08 and SELECT15/AW scan gaps, AD/AG output interruptions and BY/BA fading remain unresolved; no joins inferred. Most 68 modeled nets were spatially sampled rather than traced end-to-end; 477 model-derived contact candidates cannot establish missing-wire absence. Block and edge fits disagree by 5.28–20.84 pixels across sampled points; local warp, ownership and omission remain open. Team7 reports external schema validation passed for the original V4. Saved candidate text privately replaces 22 T-shaped glyphs with diamonds under the authorized renderer convention; original and exact inverse are retained. No electrical correctness or approval is inferred.
publication issues.qualification: Published for access with the recorded review limitations; no electrical correctness or user approval asserted.
